statement.name: GetExternalSystemDimensionValues
statement.sql: SELECT CAST( (CAST(ExternalSystemCode AS VARCHAR(3)) + '000' + CAST(ExternalSystemDimensionCode AS VARCHAR(3))) AS INT) AS LookupCode, ExternalSystemCode as LongDisplayValue, ExternalSystemDimensionCode as ShortDisplayValue, DimensionValue as DisplayValue FROM ExternalSystemDimensionValue (NOLOCK)

statement.name: GetDB_Configuration
statement.sql: SELECT ID as LookupCode, [Key] as Description, Value as Displayvalue FROM PFM_CORE_CONFIG_P (NOLOCK)

statement.name: GetLookupResourceType
statement.sql: select LookupCode, Description, ShortDisplayValue as DisplayValue from LookupResourceType (NOLOCK)

statement.name: GetLookupRoles
statement.sql: SELECT RoleId AS LookupCode ,RoleAbbr AS DisplayValue ,RoleName As LongDisplayValue FROM AC_Role ORDER BY RoleId

statement.name: GetLookupUserType
statement.sql: select LookupCode , LongDisplayValue , ShortDisplayValue , Description as DisplayValue from LookupUserType
